title: Apply for an ERider pass
summary: Learn how to apply for an ERider pass, which provides unlimited travel on the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Sydney Harbour Tunnel for motorcyclists.
intro:
ERider provides motorcyclists with a flat fee for unlimited travel on the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Sydney Harbour Tunnel. The fee payment is collected every 3 months from your ERider account.

You do not need to carry a tag as your licence plate number is photographed and matched to your ERider account.

You can apply for an ERider account online.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for an ERider pass.
To pay at a service centre, check the payment options available.
Some service centres do not accept cash payments.

faqs.q: How is the ERider fee paid?
faqs.a: The fee payment is collected every 3 months from your ERider account.

faqs.q: Do I need to carry a physical tag?
faqs.a: No, you do not need to carry a tag because your licence plate number is photographed and matched to your ERider account.

faqs.q: How can I apply for an ERider account?
faqs.a: You can apply for an ERider account online by selecting 'Apply online', choosing 'E-Rider' under 'Type of account', and following the prompts.
